description: This file defines a React functional component for testing a search tool within a UI. It manages search input, displays results, handles loading states, maintains search history, and provides UI interactions such as expanding snippets and clearing history.

methods.name: handleSearch
methods.description: Performs an async search query using provided accessToken, manages loading state, updates search history, and handles errors.

methods.name: formatTimestamp
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into a human-readable string.

methods.name: clearHistory
methods.description: Clears the search history and resets expanded results, with a success notification.

methods.name: toggleResultExpansion
methods.description: Toggles the expansion state of a specific search result snippet.
